summary.en: Self-hosted AI assistant from Tencent Cloud, with a windows-arm64 desktop installer in a beta release.
summary.zh-TW: 騰訊雲推出的自架 AI 助理，beta 版提供 windows-arm64 桌面安裝程式。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
